name: Projected VC Radius of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, every projection has one trace and empty effective range, so every effective radius is zero. For $n\ge2$, a one-coordinate projection is the full one-cube and has radius one. No projection shatters a pair. A radius at least two would imply that every pair within its effective range is shattered: extend such a pair to a set of the radius size and restrict its shattered traces. This is impossible. Hence the maximum projected radius is one.
